controller: Current chat assistant using Python tools, not local Codex CLI
initial_batch: 128 common full-domain Sobol points at seed123
visible_feedback: Per-round summaries with top5 points; decisions did not use fixed audit or competing search results
limitations: One pilot only; no statistical claim of LLM superiority
Assistant had project and finance context, so this is not an enforced blind experiment
Assistant prompts, token usage and end-to-end LLM cost are not reproducibly metered by this prototype
replay: Proposals are stored as proposal_001.json through proposal_008.json; replay exactly against the frozen checkpoint at seed123.
